# Doconnect — Doctor home visit Mumbai

> Doconnect provides doctor home visits and at-home medical care in Mumbai, India. Open 24 hours. Office: S-II C-1, BMC Colony, Anand Nagar, Andheri West, Mumbai 400053. Phone: +91 84248 45423. Email: info@doconnect.org. Website: https://www.doconnect.org

## Primary services
- Doctor home visit Mumbai (24/7)
- Nebulisation, injections, wound care, urgent care at home
- IV fluid therapy, nursing care, physiotherapy, home lab testing
- Mental health support at home

## Service areas (Mumbai)
Andheri West, Andheri, Jogeshwari, Goregaon, Malad, Ram Mandir, Vile Parle

## Booking
Call, WhatsApp, or appointment form on /contact. Not for life-threatening emergencies — use emergency services.
